senses.gloss:
Uddhava
------------------------------------------
Uddhava, the son of Devabhāga a yādava hero, was a cousin and friend of कृष्ण.
When कृष्ण decided to send the news of his welfare to the गोपीस् of वृन्दाबन् who had been very much worried, it was उद्धव who acted as his messenger.
Before कृष्ण left for his eternal Abode, उद्धव approached him for his last message. This has now become well-known as the Uddhavagītā (Bhāgavata, 11.7-29).
